newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bonds end firm in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bonds end firm in quiet trade.

text.p: 1545 GMT - Swiss bonds ended firm in quiet trade, with U.S. and U.K. markets closed for a holiday. Prices rose despite weakness in German bonds as the Swiss franc remained strong.
* June Conf ends 11 basis points higher at 120.29
* 4-1/2 pct June 2007 cash bond yields 3.49 pct vs 3.51 pct
